name: Group Policy baseline
packageArguments: Required: {"Definition":"cis-ws2022-dc-low-risk"}. Plan-only unless "Apply":"true". "LinkTo":"<OU DN in this domain>" links the GPO, disabled unless "LinkEnabled":"true". "AllowDefaultPolicy":"true" is needed, with a definition that opts in, to change a default policy. Uninstall with "Apply":"true" removes the GPO this package created or restores the last Relian backup of a default policy. Run on the PDC emulator; backups go to %ProgramData%\Relian\gpo-backups.
